name: Crunchyroll: Anime Streaming
summary:
WATCH UNLIMITED ANIME
Demon kings, giant monsters, kittens in fruit, restarting lives in other dimensions, we’ve got it all. Rule your own anime world full of new and classic series, movies, games, and more with Crunchyroll in VR.

FEATURES 
Watch subbed and dubbed, in multiple languages (dub availability varies).

New episodes drop shortly after they air in Japan so you’re never left behind.

Enjoy our massive library of anime, across every genre, always ad-free.
